title: OnsiteGene 3 Protocol for Nasal Extract Collection
author: yliu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bkugkwtw
materials: Ensure all collection materials are labelled with the correct identifying information.

steps.title: Prepare for Collection
steps.instruction: Prepare the environment and personal protective equipment for sample collection.

substeps.instruction: Clean hands using alcohol-based sanitizer or soap and water (no fragrances).
Wear appropriate PPE (at minimum, gloves and a mask).
Maintain maximum distance from the sample donor during the process.
Direct the sample donor to begin blowing their nose softly.

steps.title: Collect Nasal Swab
steps.instruction: Collect the anterior nasal swab with the assistance of a healthcare worker or technician.

substeps.instruction: Remove the lid of the collection tube containing 500 µL OnsiteGene sample storage solution.
Remove the swab from the package.
Insert the swab into each nasal passage and rotate it against the inner nasal lining in a circle three times (insert only until the tip is no longer visible).

steps.title: Secure and Label Sample
steps.instruction: Transfer the swab to the storage solution and secure the sample.

substeps.instruction: Place the swab into the storage solution in the tube.
Remove the stick through the opening point, leaving the swab pad in the tube.
Discard the stick and secure the lid.
Sterilize the tube surface with 70% ethanol or a disinfecting wipe.
Place the sample in a secondary container or an appropriately labeled biohazard bag.
Dispose of gloves and register sample collection information, including date and time.

steps.title: Prepare Sample for Extraction
steps.instruction: Mix and concentrate the collected sample.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the sample at room temperature (RNA remains stable for 3-5 days).
Vortex the collection tube for 5 seconds at 3000-5000 RPM (alternatively, tap or shake the tube to mix).
Spin down the tube for 15 seconds using a centrifuge to remove liquid from the cap and sediment solid particles.

steps.title: Extract and Purify Viral RNA
steps.instruction: Perform RNA extraction using the OnsiteGene magnetic beads instrument.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 500 µL of sample supernatant into the cartridge of the OnsiteGene magnetic beads RNA extraction instrument.
Load the cartridge into the instrument and run the extraction (duration: 6 minutes, no hands-on work).
Confirm final sample elution volume is 50 µL (instrument can process up to 32 samples per run).

steps.title: Prepare RT-qPCR Reaction
steps.instruction: Set up the reaction tubes for amplification.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 7.5 µL of extracted RNA (which can be stored at -20°C for 14 days) and 7.5 µL of OnsiteGene Hi-Sense TM COVID-19 detection kit reaction mix (containing primers and probes) into a superfast RT-qPCR reaction tube.
Secure the lid of the tube.
Spin down the tube for 15 seconds using a centrifuge or spinner.

steps.title: Run RT-qPCR Instrument
steps.instruction: Perform the real-time PCR run on the OnsiteGene XDive Superfast Real-Time PCT instrument.

substeps.instruction: Load up to 16 reaction tubes into the instrument.
Run the following thermal conditions: Step 1: 50°C for 30 sec; Step 2: 95°C for 0 sec; Step 3: 60°C for 2 sec; Step 4: Read fluorescence intensity and overhead (10 sec).
Repeat steps 2-4 for 40 cycles.

steps.title: Interpret Results
steps.instruction: Report results based on the CT values of the Internal Control (IC) and SARS-CoV-2 targets (ORF1ab and N1).

substeps.instruction: Negative: IC CT ≤ 40 and both SARS-CoV-2 targets CT > 40.
Positive: IC CT any value and any SARS-CoV-2 target CT ≤ 40.
Invalid: IC CT > 35 and both SARS-CoV-2 targets CT > 40 (indicates IC failure or insufficient specimen volume; retest sample).
